title: Landslide, Indonesia, 8 July 2024 (LS20240708IDN)
description:
UNOSAT geodata for Landslide, Indonesia, 8 July 2024 (LS20240708IDN), from 1 dataset on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. HDX describes the event:

**UNOSAT code: LS20240708IDN**  This map illustrates satellite-detected landslides in Bangio Village, Pinogu Sub-District, Bone Bolango District, Gorontalo Province, Indonesia as observed from a Sentinel-2 image acquired on 14 July 2024 at 02:17 UTC. Within the analysed area of 76 hectares, about 7 hectares of landslide scars were observed. UNITAR-UNOSAT identified 26 potentially affected structures.
This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
